notes.title: Update Info: Competitive Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Hey all! Happy to announce competitive multiplayer is now available for testing. You can enter the queue from the home screen, when a match is found a dialog box will take you to the lobby. Once both players are in the lobby the game will start. 

Competitive multiplayer has a few special rules that were designed to: 1) limit the advantage provided by using a Scrabble word finder, 2) encourage players to play in the same parts of the board, and 3) limit distractions from existing free play features.

These special rules & features:
A list of suggested words (based on the contents of your tray) is displayed, and cycles every few seconds.
Temporary bonus squares are generated at random when high-scoring moves are made. These bonus squares have new types and will appear in the vicinity of the generating move. They last for a limited number of moves, so you will need to act fast.
Tiles can not be swapped for gold, this was done to limit the benefit of having amassed a lot of gold.
An abridged leaderboard for the game is displayed to the side, and quests are not available.
Extra stat tracking, full leaderboards for which are available from the home screen.


Unfortunately, due to the number of concurrent players at any point in time, the probability of finding a match is super low. I'd encourage people to coordinate and queue up at the same time, until (if ever) this game becomes more popular.  :|

This mode is not fully polished, if you encounter any issues please reach out to me at feedback@spellingquest.online, or here on Steam in the discussions section. 

For an overview of upcoming work you can take a look at: https://trello.com/b/A1m10hxI/spelling-quest-online. 

I also made a Discord server, I don't know if anyone would want/use this, but it exists and the invite is fvuSXMN.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Info: New Board Sizes & AI
notes.notes:
Hey all!

You can now select a board size when creating a game. There are a few preset options available:
10x10
50x50
100x100 (default)
200x200
400x400

There are a few places in the code where we assume boards are square, once I rewrite those, I'll drop the restrictions and allow basically any choice (within reasonable limits). The free-play default board will be 1000x1000 going forward just for fun. 

An AI opponent can be included when creating a game. This feature is on a trial basis. I've done some testing and it's been hard to make them 1) play like humans would, 2) use a reasonable amount of CPU on my servers, 3) not be ridiculously overpowered. I suspect they'll go through a few more iterations before they're actually fun to play against. 

There's now a tutorial that any new players on Steam will see when they first link their account. It's pretty short and has a gold reward for finishing it. 

Once again thanks to everyone who's given this a chance!

notes.title: Bug Fix: Challenge Leaderboards
notes.notes: Challenge leaderboards will once again display, and missing scores have been back-filled.

notes.title: Update Info: Steam Overlay & More!
notes.notes:
Patch notes
The Steam overlay should now correctly display throughout the game.
The Options menu (accessible from the main menu) will let you toggle fullscreen.
Fullscreen in general should be less finicky than it was before.
A new challenge mode is available with a daily leaderboard. In Survival you have a limited supply of tiles, which can be replenished through pickups on the board. Your score is based on the number of tiles you can place in an hour (or until you run out!). 


I also wanted to share my work board, where I'm tracking what I'm working on and what's coming up next: you can see it here. 

If you have any questions or comments you can always reach me directly at feedback@spellingquest.online, or in the Discussions section on Steam.
